note: Posts the owner approves for the automatic launcher (scripts/launch.mjs): the X status ids of data/trending-cats.json posts that are not watch-list cats (a real pet, a name the rules guessed), or of any X cat post: one the trend watch has not read is looked up by id on its next run (saving this file starts it) and listed. An approved post still meets every other rule: not sensitive, not already in the sanctuary, at most 48 hours old, a picture, a clean name and X post, the caps. Add an id to approve it; remove it to take the approval back before it is prepared. A post that names no cat (a big account's cat post, listed under signals) launches when you name it: { "post": "<id or link>", "name": "<the cat's name>" }, with an optional "ticker" (else from the name), "kind" (real, cartoon or fiction; else real) and "lore" (one line about the cat; else the post's first sentence). Saving this file starts the launcher. The launcher only reads this file. A sanctuary cat posted while the trend watch could not read pump.fun (data/trending.json fresh.gaps) launches once its own post id is here: the owner has looked on pump.fun for a coin under its name. The real-cats rule (LAUNCH_CHARACTERS off) has one exception, per post: a naming with "kind": "cartoon" or "fiction" and "character": true is the owner's explicit approval of that one character coin (2026-10-10: Schrödinger's Cat). Type the name's accents as single letters (é, ö) and keep words like dead or death out of the lore.
